reviews.text: I really like this suncream the only reason it gets 4 stars is i prefer cosrx ultra lightweight invisible suncream. This one has a smell and it is not a bad smell what so ever its just something I enjoy. Its kinda like aloe just more. It does occasionally have a tendency to sting my eyes but rarely and I have super sensitive eyes I cant really use any American sunscreen because of this. Good sunscreen just have one I like better
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款防曬霜，只係因為我更鍾意 cosrx ultra lightweight invisible 防曬霜，所以只俾咗4星。呢款有味道，但係一啲都唔難聞，只係我鍾意嘅味道。有啲似蘆薈，但係更加濃。佢偶爾會有刺痛眼睛嘅傾向，但係好少，我嘅眼睛好敏感，因為咁，我基本上用唔到美國品牌嘅防曬。呢款係好防曬，只係我有一款更鍾意嘅。

reviews.text: I was in need of a light-weight sun cream that leaves no white cast. Tocobo definitely fits the bill. It's got a milky texture that blends right into the skin, leaving no white-cast (I have a medium brown complexion). It can have a bit of a tacky feel when it dries down, and depending on the day's skin care routine, I did see some pilling. The scent may be a drawback for some, as it smells like carnations, but the scent does fade after application.
reviews.zh: 我需要一款輕盈、唔會留白嘅防曬霜。Tocobo 絕對啱晒要求。佢係乳液質地，可以好快推勻落皮膚，唔會留白（我嘅膚色係中等偏深啡色）。乾咗之後會有少少黏手嘅感覺，而且視乎嗰日嘅護膚步驟，我有見到有少少搓泥。味道可能係某啲人嘅缺點，因為佢聞落似康乃馨，不過塗完之後味道會淡返。

reviews.text: I loved this product and have purchased it many times. It's very light and hydrating and has a glowy finish. I think if you have oily skin you might not like it. It also has a strongish botanical smell, not really floral just planty, that I like but could be overpowering if you're sensitive to smells. it sits very nice under makeup.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款產品，已經買過好多次。佢好輕盈、保濕，而且有亮澤嘅效果。我諗如果你係油性皮膚，可能唔會鍾意。佢有少少濃嘅植物香，唔係花香，更似植物嘅味道，我好鍾意，但係如果你對味道敏感，可能會覺得太搶。佢疊喺妝下面都好服貼。

reviews.text: I was afraid this would be overhyped, but that’s not the case! This isn’t as thick as sunscreen typically is, but it’s not too runny where I’d feel I’d have to apply multiple layers for coverage. It doesn’t leave a dewy finish which I prefer, but it did leavey dry skin moisturized. I would repurchase.
reviews.zh: 我本來擔心佢會被過度炒作，但係唔係咁嘅！佢唔似一般防曬咁厚身，但係亦都唔會太稀，唔使塗好多層先夠覆蓋。佢唔會留低水潤嘅光澤，呢點我鍾意，不過佢確實令我乾燥嘅皮膚有咗滋潤。我會再買。

reviews.text: Unfortunately this made me break out really bad. The smell is also not pleasant. It smells precisely like the white powder “flower food” you get when you buy fresh cut flowers. The packaging is cute and the consistency is watery.
reviews.zh: 好可惜，呢款令我起咗好多暗瘡。味道都唔好聞，佢嘅味道正正似買鮮花時附送嘅白色粉狀「鮮花保鮮粉」。包裝好可愛，質地就係水嘅。

reviews.text:
Mi pedido llego a Ontario, Canada casi 14 dias despues y tuve que pagar un fee $ 22
00 por retirar mi Paquete de Canada Post
Pero este sunscreen es buenisimo yo tengo combination skin pero Como uso retinol se me Seca y pela la cara solo alredodor de la boca.
Este sunscreen me hidrata 100% y no me deja brillosa la cara y no me irritan los ojos.
Lo volveria usar es super liquido y un poco de olor pero rico
reviews.zh:
我嘅訂單大約14日後先到安大略省（加拿大），我要俾 $ 22
00 費用先可以喺 Canada Post 取件。
但係呢款防曬真係好好。我係混合性皮膚，但係因為我用緊維 A 醇，令我只有口周圍嘅面乾身同起皮。
呢款防曬 100% 保濕，唔會令我面油光，又唔會令我眼睛痛。
我會再用，佢超級清透，有少少味道，不過好好聞。

reviews.text: I LOVE this sunscreen. It’s very thin and quick to absorb with 0 white cast. I’m obsessed with the way it smells like fresh cut roses, it’s very natural and not perfume like, but if you’re highly sensitive to fragrance this may not be the product for you. My only complaint is that it pills my Ilia primer, but it seems to layer fine with other makeup products. I find myself teaching for the round lab sunscreen on days where I’m wearing heavier makeup but this has become my daily go to!
reviews.zh: 我超級鍾意呢款防曬！佢好薄、吸收快，完全冇白色殘留。我好迷佢嗰種好似鮮切玫瑰嘅味道，好天然，唔似香水咁，但係如果你對香味好敏感，呢款可能唔啱你。我唯一嘅不滿係佢會令我嘅 Ilia 妝前乳搓泥，不過同其他化妝品疊起嚟就冇問題。我化較厚嘅妝嗰日，我會轉用 Round Lab 防曬，但係呢款已經成為我嘅日常首選！

reviews.text: i love this sunscreen. feels so lightweight on my skin but not drying whatsoever. perfect for summer, but might not be moisturising enough for winter time if you have dry skin like me. this is a perfect holy grail summer time sunscreen though, i used to hate applying sunscreen because it takes forever to absorb but this one has a watery texture that gets absorbed very fast.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款防曬。塗落皮膚好輕盈，而且完全唔乾身。夏天好啱用，但係如果你好似我咁係乾性皮膚，冬天可能保濕唔夠。不過呢款絕對係夏天嘅「神級」防曬。我以前好唔鍾意塗防曬，因為好耐先吸收，但係呢款質地好似水咁，吸收好快。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
